title: Synthesizing Sources and Conducting Formal Debate
summary: Combining evidence across sources, weighing uncertainty, and defending a qualified position in formal debate.
whyItMatters: Synthesis creates a new, evidence-based overview instead of presenting isolated summaries, while formal debate tests that overview against objections and alternatives.

mentalModel.title: Organize by claim, not by source
mentalModel.content: Bring several sources together under shared questions, patterns, disagreements, and gaps.

mentalModel.title: A strong position has conditions
mentalModel.content: State what you support, why, under which safeguards, and which evidence would make you revise it.

ruleBlocks.title: Build a synthesis matrix
ruleBlocks.content: Compare source claims, methods, evidence strength, assumptions, and relevance before drafting.

ruleBlocks.title: Formulate a qualified thesis
ruleBlocks.content: Combine a clear recommendation with limits, conditions, uncertainty, and ethical priorities.

ruleBlocks.title: Engage the strongest objection
ruleBlocks.content: Restate it accurately, concede valid points, answer with evidence, and adjust the proposal when warranted.

tables.title: Synthesis and Debate Toolkit
rows: Mehrere Quellen deuten darauf hin, dass ...
Unter der Voraussetzung, dass ..., spricht vieles für ...
Der Einwand ist insofern berechtigt, als ...
Daraus folgt jedoch nicht zwingend, dass ...
Sollten neue Daten zeigen, dass ..., müsste ...

examples.de: Mehrere Studien berichten einen Nutzen, unterscheiden sich jedoch deutlich in Stichprobe und Beobachtungsdauer.
examples.en: Several studies report a benefit but differ considerably in sample and observation period.

examples.de: Unter der Voraussetzung unabhängiger Kontrolle spricht vieles für einen begrenzten Pilotversuch.
examples.en: Provided there is independent oversight, there is much to support a limited pilot trial.

examples.de: Der Einwand möglicher Fehlanreize ist berechtigt; daraus folgt jedoch eher eine strengere Gestaltung als ein vollständiger Verzicht.
examples.en: The objection concerning possible perverse incentives is justified; however, it supports stricter design rather than complete abandonment.

commonMistakes.wrong: Summarize source A, then B, then C without integration.
commonMistakes.correct: Structure paragraphs around a shared claim or disagreement.

commonMistakes.wrong: Defend an absolute position despite uncertainty.
commonMistakes.correct: State safeguards, thresholds, and revision conditions.
commonMistakes.reason: Qualified positions are often more rigorous, not weaker.

comparisons.summary: The theme supplies standards for evidence, uncertainty, ethics, and adaptive governance.
Complex conditionals make assumptions and revision criteria explicit.
